note: The scorer's own output for the EB-NeRD semantic submission (predictions.zip) on Codabench competition 2469, transcribed from the scores.json the leaderboard returned. This is a SUBSET: the full response also carries per-slice sentiment, category and topic distributions over the 200,000 beyond-accuracy rows -- several hundred keys of Danish topic labels -- which nothing in this repo cites. The headline metrics, the starred variants, the per-day breakdown and the overall coverage block are kept verbatim because they are the figures the design note and the manifest quote.

starred_variant.note: The scorer reports a second set of the same four metrics under starred keys (auc*, mrr*, ...). What distinguishes them from the unstarred set is NOT documented by the organisers and we did not determine it; they are recorded because they exist and differ in the fourth decimal place, not because we can interpret them. Nothing in the design note cites them.

beyond_accuracy_coverage.note: Computed by the organisers over the 200,000 beyond-accuracy rows against a 250-item reference set -- a different denominator from our own coverage metric, which is distinct articles over the whole corpus. The two are NOT comparable and the design note does not compare them.

beyond_accuracy_sentiment_top5.note: Sentiment mix of the top-5 recommendations over the 200,000 beyond-accuracy rows, as labelled by the organisers' own article sentiment field.
